scripts.dev:vizij-standalone: node scripts/check-snap-env.mjs && pnpm --filter vizij-standalone run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.format: pnpm run markdown:fix && pnpm exec prettier --write .
scripts.format:check: pnpm run markdown:check && pnpm exec prettier --check .
scripts.prep: pnpm run format && pnpm run validate
scripts.prep:all: pnpm run format && pnpm run validate:all
scripts.prep:push: pnpm run format && pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && pnpm run validate:all
scripts.lint: pnpm run markdown:check && pnpm run adaptations:check && ./scripts/run-affected.sh lint
scripts.lint:all: pnpm run markdown:check && pnpm run adaptations:check && pnpm -r run --if-present lint
scripts.validate: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.validate:all: pnpm run lint:all && pnpm run typecheck:all && pnpm run test:all
scripts.reset:hard: pnpm -r run --if-present reset:hard && rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml
scripts.verify:packages: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --filter "@vizij/*" run --if-present lint && pnpm -r --filter "@vizij/*" run --if-present test
scripts.ci:version: pnpm run version:packages && pnpm run format
scripts.release:ci: pnpm run verify:packages && pnpm run ci:publish
